Card Q&A.a: Digimon carry over effects after digivolving or de-digivolving, so you still have to delete this Digimon at the end of the turn.
Card Q&A.q: After using this Digimon's effect to digivolve it into [AncientGreymon], I digivolve (or de-digivolve) it into another Digimon. Do I still have to delete it at the end of the turn?

Card Q&A.a:
They both trigger at the same time, so you can choose which order to activate them in. The one you activate first takes precedence.

Card Q&A.a:
Digimon carry over effects after digivolving, so [AncientGreymon] is the Digimon re-played in your battle area.
